# Little Crayon Tales

> Story books kids color AND read. One big picture and one short sentence in big, easy letters on every page. For ages 3-6, sold on Amazon.

Each book is a paperback printed and sold by Amazon. Every page has one full-page coloring picture with bold, thick lines and one short sentence in big letters; together the pages tell one story. Best with crayons and colored pencils.

## Books

- [Nico the Little Reindeer’s Snowy Day](/books/nico-the-little-reindeer/): Snow angels, sledding and a snowman with Tilly the penguin. Ages 3-6, 29 pictures, 8.5 x 8.5 in paperback. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLVTTK7T
- [Benny the Bear’s Cozy Day](/books/benny-the-bear/): Pancakes, a kite, hide and seek and a bedtime story. Ages 3-6, 27 pictures, 8.5 x 8.5 in paperback. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLVSLXK7
- [Dex the Little Dinosaur’s Big Day](/books/dex-the-little-dinosaur/): A pterodactyl friend, a hatching egg and a rumbling volcano. Ages 3-6, 29 pictures, 8.5 x 11 in paperback. Coming soon.
